column1: # tests/expected/poke_readback.tsv — THE POKE READ-BACK CLASSIFICATION (GitHub #171 slice Q6, shape 4).
# One row per finding of tools/audit_poke_readback.py: a gate that SAMPLES an address its own rig
# POKES. class: UNCLASSIFIED (the maintainer's to rule, one by one), OBSERVES (the poke sets the
# stage, the game changes it, the gate measures the change — grows only), READS-BACK (the column
# records the rig, not the engine — shrinks only: a READS-BACK column is dropped from the compare or
# labelled in the gate's header as a rig record), CONTROL-PLANT (a known-bad plant on a control leg that
# reads its poke back BY DESIGN), CROSS-LEG (the census joined a poke on one leg to a dump on ANOTHER leg
# that runs with no poke — a census limitation: it compares addresses per gate, not per leg), RETIRED (the
# finding no longer derives; kept for the record). The 73 UNCLASSIFIED rows were ruled 2026-09-25 (14z-181,
# DECISIONS_HISTORY.md "Ruled 2026-09-25 (14z-181)"), each note naming its deciding line; a READS-BACK
# column dropped from its gate is RETIRED with the ruling in its note. Gate: tests/test_poke_readback.sh — every derived finding has a row, every live row derives.
# leg: main (the measuring leg's poke), control (a poke on a line naming a plant, a control or a mode — a
# known-bad plant that reads its poke back by design; rule-checker run 2026-09-24-144) or mixed.
